campaign_name: PR-BR Continuation 12 — Fast-Path Competence, Discourse Typing & Contract-Honoring Resolution
purpose: Make the fast path abstain when a parse is semantically incomplete, keep interlocutor identity out of active_claim, and stop a validated contract from being denied or replaced by a generic nonanswer. Six focused live turns. No smoke. No 4x10 gate. PR-BR remains open.
executive_summary: Fast-path success now requires the operation's missing pieces, not merely a recognized verb. Elliptical, referential, and multi-reference lines bind uniquely or abstain into one interpretation call. An interlocutor name cannot become active_claim. A satisfying Gate Guard or notice-board answer is not replaced by an absence line or the canned wear line. Deterministic band: 256 passed, 0 failed. Live turns: 6. Fast path: 2. Abstentions: 4. Remaining break: useful generated answers on turns 2 and 3 were still replaced downstream. READY FOR INDEPENDENT 10-TURN SMOKE: NO. READY FOR FULL SYNTHETIC GATE: NO. HUMAN PLAYTEST: NOT AUTHORIZED.
